title: Proposed asset sale of Bright Telecommunications

body_sections.Summary: Bright Telecommunications, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Western Power, is a provider of fibre optic customer access networks to a small number of suburbs in Perth.
body_sections.Market definition: The supply of broadband customer access networks in metropolitan Perth.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Bright Telecommunications has only a small market share. Consequently the proposed sale of the Bright Telecommunications assets by Western Power is unlikely to substantially lessen competition.
